summary: Expose the GitHub plugin's seven read-only client routes and regenerated clients

replay.detail: Read-only requests do not write claims or change replay behavior.

schema.detail: No persistent store, claims, tables or schema-version changes. The bounded cache is process-local and is discarded on restart.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated fleet upgrade requirement.

compatibility.detail: Adds seven client-v0 read.projections routes for pull requests, issues, comments, conversation, checks, files and runs under /v1/client/plugins/github. Existing routes remain unchanged. The new generated client methods require a daemon containing these routes; older daemons do not serve them. TypeScript answers are typed and Rust/Swift answers use raw JSON inside the existing Envelope. Repository-id redirects are resolved through a fixed-host repository lookup and returned as moved, not followed to the item.

downtime.detail: Activation requires the ordinary daemon binary rollout and restart. No migration or additional startup work is introduced; restart interruption duration was not measured.

manual.detail: No store migration, claim conversion or new credentials are required. Reads use existing daemon GitHub credentials and admission accounting. A daemon rollout from merged main is requested immediately after merge.

recovery.detail: No new persistent-state rollback restriction. Rolling back removes the added routes; new clients must stop using them until the updated daemon is restored.
